entities.summary: Alejandro Zohn Rosenthal was a Mexican architect of Austrian-Jewish origin. His works are renowned for the contributions to modern architecture in Mexico, particularly in Guadalajara where his works such as the San Juan de Dios Market have left a lasting impact on Mexico's modernist architecture.
